whatToChoose.question: Not sure what to choose?
whatToChoose.answer: Choose GB Proxies if you have many requests and price per volume matters. Choose Unlimited if you need long sessions, high speed, and 24/7 operation.

threads.question: How many threads can I run?
threads.answer: Typically 50–150, depending on your workload and tools.

customize.question: Can I customize connection settings?
customize.answer: Yes — you can customize region, city, session, and TTL parameters directly in the connection string.

protocols.question: What protocols do you support?
protocols.answer: We support HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, HTTP/3, and UDP-based traffic where applicable. Our infrastructure is optimized for modern protocols, low-latency routing, automatic failover, and load balancing.

logs.question: Do you keep logs of my activity?
logs.answer: No, we maintain a strict zero-logs policy. We don't store, monitor, or log any of your browsing activity or data. We only keep minimal connection metadata for service optimization and billing purposes, which is automatically deleted after 30 days.

refunds.question: Do you offer refunds?
refunds.answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for all plans.

countries.question: What countries are available?
countries.answer: We support 100+ countries including US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, and many more. Check available countries in the API documentation.

tryBefore.question: Can I try proxies before purchasing?
tryBefore.answer: Yes! You can test basic functionality. For production use, we recommend our premium plans.

apiDocs.question: Where can I find API documentation?
apiDocs.answer: You can find detailed API documentation, including connection string customization, available countries, and integration examples in our API Documentation section.
